name: python-lint
description: Reference engine lint (ruff) on every push and pull request.

name: python-tests-coverage
description: Reference engine tests with the 90% coverage floor.

name: typescript-tests-coverage
description: TypeScript engine tests with the coverage floor.

name: java-check
description: Java engine build, tests, and JaCoCo coverage floor via Gradle check.

name: offline-assessment
description: Real offline proof: an assessment runs inside a Linux network namespace with no route off the host. Linux/sudo-only, so it is wired and gated in CI but not smoke-run in the eval.

name: no-ml-selftest
description: Proves the no-learned-components denylist scan has teeth (seeded ML framework in each lockfile format is caught).

name: no-ml-scan
description: Scans every lockfile (uv, pnpm, gradle) in the tree for a denylisted ML/LLM dependency.

name: leak-guard-selftest
description: Proves the private/public leakage guard detects a sentinel private term and denylisted phrase without disclosing either list.

name: leak-guard-no-disclosure
description: Confirms the committed guard artifacts themselves disclose no private term.

name: leak-guard-diff
description: Scans added content and commit messages against the base commit. Needs the CI-provided base SHA, so it is wired and gated in CI but not smoke-run in the eval.

name: spec-validate-vocab
description: Validates the evidence vocabulary for internal consistency.

name: spec-validate-examples
description: Validates the worked examples against their schemas.
